verdict: The documents describe the required transparent SQL product accurately, with explicit conservative correctness-first choices. Current498 source supplies routing/planning/local snapshot components, not the proposed transparent executor, global snapshot/join runtime or durable production SQL coordinator. No existing abstract API or native Image receipt proves those gaps closed.

requirements_review.requirement: Logical locality is an optional optimization
requirements_review.design: distributed-sql-design sections1,7/lines325-341; minimum contract introductory scope
requirements_review.assessment: Design satisfies requirement: stable versioned logical domain/key policy, related tables may share domain, absent policy and forced separation retain same atomic correctness. Locality migration needs versioned route lookup/cutover.
requirements_review.actual_source: distribution.rs1003-1015 hashes namespace+key with fixed versioned SHA256; distribution_range_consensus2698 uses collection+record_id. No implemented SQL tenant/locality declaration inferred.
requirements_review.status: Design contract reviewed; implementation gap open; runtime locality migration not tested.

requirements_review.requirement: Ordinary PG clients through healthy fixed endpoint
requirements_review.assessment: Gateway must intercept both simple and extended protocol before local DB guards, carry authenticated app/RLS/schema/session/portal/operation state, execute typed fragments and hide stale routes only when execution is disproven or same durable outcome resolved. No client range IDs/leader choice. Fixed endpoint needs an operational gateway/LB service; losing socket may remain standard uncertain COMMIT, not transparent connection migration.
requirements_review.actual_source: pgwire/lib.rs4132 local SQL dispatch,4498 existing connection transaction,4683/4690 SqlSession from borrowed local BicDb; server_cluster.rs1041 route_point and1061/1078/1095 explicit planning methods. Source hooks do not demonstrate automatic ordinary SQL forwarding.
requirements_review.status: Planning/session primitives implemented; transparent range SQL execution not established; endpoint movement acceptance not tested by this review.

requirements_review.assessment: Same exact global decided/read prefix S for all fragments, actual retained per-range S->B_r mapping, schema/backing/lineage pins and token filters. A local lower floor/latest snapshot is insufficient. Missing/expired fragment must error, never return successful subset. SQL NULL/duplicates/outer joins/exact NUMERIC/security semantics and bounded spill need executable operators.
requirements_review.actual_source: distribution_query.rs259-438 generic caller-supplied executor/explicit partial response mode; record_read_snapshot.rs15-22 instance_id/local snapshot+pending overlay,62 rejects another DB instance. These are not shared remote read certificates or relational joins.
requirements_review.status: Generic bounded helper and local view implemented; global SQL view/joins not established; not runtime-tested here.

requirements_review.requirement: Atomic multi-range business writes and coordinator recovery
requirements_review.assessment: Registry and invisible participant intents must be actual durable replicated state. Enlist before intent; freeze exact participant/digest set; immutable quorum decision; prepared claims survive leader/coordinator loss; independent resolver resolves every enlisted/contacted recipient including lost prepare reply. Terminal COMMIT cannot turn into ABORT on timeout. First ACK waits all durable apply/visibility and published S.
requirements_review.actual_source: distribution_query.rs1054 trait has begin/prepare/decision/commit/abort/finish, no status/enumeration/recover methods; sole impl1602 is cfg(test) RecordingCommitProtocol. execute_distributed_transaction1120 explicitly normal SQL never invokes;1152 aborts only counted successfully prepared prefix after failure, potentially excluding a recipient whose prepare reply was lost. No production correctness inferred from helper.
requirements_review.status: Abstract sequencing only; production durable SQL registry/intent/recovery service not established; exact lost-reply scenario remains required acceptance.

requirements_review.design: report section7 lines343-351; minimum section3 lines109-119
requirements_review.assessment: Initial conservative stage may drain/block active prepares/pins with bounded reasons. Final online movement must transfer versions/read mappings/intents/claims/decision ancestry, fence old authority and preserve stable logical participant lineage. Node replacement or joining alone does not prove those handoffs. Gateway refresh must not convert catching-up unavailable into false absence.
requirements_review.actual_source: distribution_range_consensus2699 rejects cross-range final-row intents;2710 rejects current nonleader. Native recovery/image staging is a different authority domain from SQL 2PC votes.
requirements_review.status: Explicit staged design, not full online relocation implementation/qualification.

design_decisions_still_required: A single decision domain and all-participant visible prefix are conservative correctness choices with central throughput and head-of-line availability costs. Measure registry/visibility capacity and disconnected participant behavior; do not claim node addition increases throughput from this design.

Minimum section4 initially admits read-only RC/RR. Accounting read/write acceptance needs own-intent visibility, write-conflict/constraint ownership and exact frozen participants. Local SSI is insufficient for advertised global SERIALIZABLE; reject that isolation until actual global claims/validation exist.
Persistent reader/writer capability fence must ensure legacy SQL/Get and other write APIs cannot bypass shared S and expose later physical versions or unregistered writes.

Choose executable typed fragments, remote authentication/RLS authority, logical-object to actual backing mapping, schema/DDL lifetime and format downgrade refusal. Local Arc, table name/OID or matching fingerprint cannot become remote permission.

Define transaction status/receipt resolution accessible through ordinary SQL/session facilities without application shard routing. Stable business operation UUID is permissible business idempotency; gateway-generated TxID/status cannot require application selection of physical ranges. Lost socket COMMIT remains uncertain until resolved.

Define constraint/index/audit/queue/outbox participants, visibility, GC/tombstones and backup/restore common cut. Prepared transaction/data bytes cannot be discarded merely because a client or old actor disappeared.
Blocking movement until pins/prepares drain is an honest first capability gate. It cannot satisfy final bounded online scale-out with continuous transactions by itself.

minimum_end_to_end_acceptance.execution_status: Proposed future end-to-end acceptance; not executable as a passing current498 capability and not run by this review.
minimum_end_to_end_acceptance.smallest_component_environment: Three independent data OS processes, RF3 across >=2 ranges, replicated transaction registry quorum, two SQL gateways behind one stable ordinary endpoint, separate stock PostgreSQL driver and fsynced external ledger. Harness alone chooses fixture account/receipt keys occupying distinct ranges; application carries only SQL and business IDs.
minimum_end_to_end_acceptance.business_schema: accounts(id PRIMARY KEY,balance NUMERIC); receipts(operation_id PRIMARY KEY,from_id,to_id,amount NUMERIC), exact business payload/hash retained externally. Seed independently verified balances.
minimum_end_to_end_acceptance.sql: BEGIN; UPDATE accounts SET balance=balance-$3 WHERE id=$1; UPDATE accounts SET balance=balance+$3 WHERE id=$2; INSERT INTO receipts VALUES($4,$1,$2,$3); COMMIT;
fault_schedule: After actual durable prepare on one participant but before its response, drop that reply and kill actual gateway/coordinator. New owner must discover that same participant/intent and reach one lawful terminal outcome; no orphan or unilateral timeout abort.

After actual durable COMMIT decision but before one participant apply/visibility receipt, kill coordinator. Independent resolver must finish original TxID/payload/decision; client may be uncertain, never silently rolled back or duplicated.

After success response recorded in external ACK ledger, kill coordinator plus replace a range leader within allowed RF3 failure envelope; every acknowledged exact operation survives, not just total balance.

During a delayed apply, concurrent plain SQL join of accounts+receipts from either gateway sees one exact read view with all-or-none debit/credit/receipt, or explicit bounded unavailable; never fractured success/false not-found.

Repeat same SQL with no locality, colocation and forced separation. Change range leader between Parse/Bind/Execute; stock driver retains one endpoint with zero range/leader hints. Hold named portal across later commits and require exact original view or explicit expiration.
minimum_end_to_end_acceptance.reconciliation: Durably record every attempt before send and every actual ACK/uncertain/failed/retried result separately. Verify original per-operation debit, credit, exact payload and exactly one matching receipt plus reference query answers; total balance alone is insufficient. Unknown is not rollback. Any business retry uses the same operation UUID/payload and normal whole-transaction conflict/unique handling, never shard-managed partial retry.
minimum_end_to_end_acceptance.movement_extension: After correctness component passes, use same client/endpoint and ledger on four->five independent nodes. Add node via supported membership, wait actual data+leadership/load convergence, inject faults at real intent/history handoff, and verify old authority fences. Initial movement refusal is reported as bounded blockage, not successful online relocation.
minimum_end_to_end_acceptance.capacity_extension: Separately compare stable four-node vs fully converged five-node sustained successful read/write/mixed throughput at identical p95/p99 and error budgets. Relocation-period throughput kept separate; central registry bottleneck and all-participant frontier stalls explicitly measured.
minimum_end_to_end_acceptance.publication: Pin source/version/binary SHA, complete topology/placement/fsync settings, source ledger and client payloads, actual fault phase/proof, raw latency/error samples, retained logs and safe logical evidence. Processes on one machine prove neither independent-host fault safety nor production capacity; existing Azure failed run remains failed.

qualification: No transparent distributed SQL runtime, HA, physical throughput gain, cold recovery, production artifact or deployment was produced or qualified by this read-only review.
